name: 0.1.0-beta.17
notes:
# Folian Desktop Beta 17

- Choose where to store native projects and find or open .folian documents in Finder. Create a portable copy of an existing library project whenever you need one. Existing projects continue to work without migration.
- Reveal readable manuscript Markdown, individual chapter and scene files, and the Story Bible in Markdown and JSON. The files include Research entries and their sources, structured project records, and project history.
- Export your manuscript to Word. Edit individual scenes in Word or Markdown, then import revisions to compare and approve or reject them before Folian applies a change.
- Connect Claude or Codex through MCP for read access. You can also enable manuscript and Story Bible proposals and decide which changes to apply.
- Keep using Folian’s native AI integrations and continue writing offline.
- Files generated by Folian do not sync external edits automatically. Revision import supports individual scenes. Full-manuscript DOCX revision import is not included.
